title: 出
teacherNotes: Teacher approved L072 new character `出` and the five final sentences in chat. Current latest origin/main is L069 `朵`; L070 `了`, L071/L072 including `畫` are not all production truth yet, so prepare L072 assets only and do not merge to production until L070-L072 are merged and rechecked. `出` should be read ㄔㄨ. Keep `畫` as the traditional character and use Taiwan zhuyin only.

approvedSentences.reason: Practices `出` in `拿出`, reviews `包`, `花`, and `朵`, and has a clear bag-and-flowers picture.

approvedSentences.text: 我畫不出來，我不要畫了
approvedSentences.spokenText: 我畫不出來我不要畫了
approvedSentences.reason: Practices `不出來`, reviews `畫` and `了`, and shows a child stopping a difficult drawing.

approvedSentences.text: 爸爸出門了，我也要出門
approvedSentences.spokenText: 爸爸出門了我也要出門
approvedSentences.reason: Practices `出門`, reviews `了`, and creates a concrete family doorway scene.
Practices `看不出` with learned identity words; teacher explicitly approved keeping this sentence.

approvedSentences.text: 這個包包上的花朵好可愛
approvedSentences.spokenText: 這個包包上的花朵好可愛
approvedSentences.reason: Reviews `包`, `花`, `朵`, `好`, and `可愛`; provides a clear visual review sentence without `出`.
